As an ISP, we have invested and expect to continue to invest in selective fiber to the home (“FTTH”) deployments in select markets in the United States.

Given the significant upfront build and operational investments for these FTTH deployments, there is risk that we may not fully recover these investments as a result of future technological and regulatory changes, competitive responses from incumbent local providers, and slower than expected market penetration or otherwise.
Following closing and satisfaction of certain post-closing obligations to CSU, which are expected to occur by the end of April 2027, the Company's parent guaranty will be released.
The increased competition in the market for Internet services in recent years, which we expect will continue to intensify in the short and long term, poses a material risk for us.

In each case, the Company records a reduction of revenues that reflects expected refunds, rebates, and credit card charge-backs at the time of the sale based on historical experiences and current expectations.

Although we still provide mobile telephony services to a small subset of customers retained through the Ting Mobile brand as part of the EchoStar Purchase Agreement executed in Fiscal 2020, this revenue stream no longer represents the Company's strategic focus going forward.
Based on this assessment, we expect the carrying amount of our outstanding receivables, net of allowance for doubtful accounts, to be fully collected.

During the three months and nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company recorded an impairment loss of $10.7 million primarily related to abandoned materials and supplies held for capital projects, as well as impairment of right-of-use operating lease assets.

In the three months ended September 30, 2025, the Company recorded a gain on disposition of property and equipment of $4.0 million, primarily related to the disposition of Ting inventory held for capital projects.

In the nine months ended September 30, 2026, the Company recorded a loss on disposition of property and equipment of $0.8 million, primarily related to the disposition of Ting contract assets and inventory held for capital projects.

In the nine months ended September 30, 2025, the Company recorded a gain on disposition of property and equipment of $5.8 million, primarily related to the disposition of Ting inventory held for capital projects.
The Company ended September 30, 2026 with a remaining principal balance of $184.4 million, of which $21.1 million will be due in 2027 and $163.3 million will be due in 2029.

For Fiscal 2026, the Company plans to fund the cash requirements of Tucows businesses excluding Ting solely through operating income, while making discretionary loan repayments to create greater operating flexibility and access to additional financing.

estimates.t: The preparation of our Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements in accordance with GAAP requires management to make estimates and assumptions that affect the reported amounts of assets, liabilities, revenues and expenses, and related disclosure of contingent assets and liabilities.

estimates.name: Ting
estimates.t: Ting and its subsidiaries, Cedar and Simply Bits, includes the provision of high-speed Internet access services to select towns throughout the United States.

estimates.name: Wavelo — Platform Services
estimates.t: Tucows' Platform Services include the following full-service platforms from Wavelo, including MONOS, ISOS, SM and our legacy Platypus ISP Billing software.

estimates.name: Other Professional Services
estimates.t: This revenue stream includes any other professional services earned in connection with the Wavelo business from the provision of standalone technology services development work.

estimates.name: Tucows Domains
estimates.t: The Company generates Tucows Domains revenues primarily through Wholesale Domains Services, Wholesale Value Added Services and Retail.

estimates.name: Domain registration and WHOIS Privacy Services
estimates.t: Domain registration contracts, which can be purchased for terms of one to ten years, provide our resellers and retail registrant customers with the exclusive right to a personalized internet address from which to build an online presence.

estimates.name: Tucows Registry Services
estimates.t: Tucows Registry Services provides registry platform and related technical services to operators of generic top-level domains, branded top-level domains, and country code top-level domains.

estimates.name: Value Added Services
estimates.t: Domain related value-added services like digital certificates and hosted email provide our resellers and retail registrant customers with tools and additional functionality to be used in conjunction with domain registrations.

estimates.name: Expiry
estimates.t: The Company also sells the rights to the Company’s portfolio domains or names acquired through the Company’s domain expiry stream.

estimates.name: Advertising
estimates.t: Given that the variable consideration is calculated and paid on a monthly basis, no estimation of variable consideration is required.

estimates.name: Corporate and other - Mobile services and eliminations
estimates.t: Though a significant portion of the Company’s domain services revenues are prepaid by our customers, where the Company does collect receivables, management judgment is required at the time revenue is recorded to assess whether the collection of the resulting receivables is reasonably assured.

estimates.name: Ting
estimates.t: Ting generated $22.3 million in net revenue during the three months ended September 30, 2026, up $5.3 million, or 31%, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Wavelo — Platform Services
estimates.t: Net revenues from Wavelo Platform Services for the three months ended September 30, 2026, decreased by $0.1 million, or 1%, to $11.7 million as compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Other Professional Services
estimates.t: Net revenues from Other Professional Services was nil f or both the three months ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025, as well as the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and the nine months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Tucows Domains — Wholesale - Domain Services
estimates.t: During the three months ended September 30, 2026, Wholesale domain services net revenue decreased by $3.0 million, or 6%, to $48.9 million as compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025.

estimates.name: Wholesale - Value Added Services
estimates.t: During the three months ended September 30, 2026, value-added services net revenue decreased by $1.0 million, or 17%, to $5.1 million as compared to the three months ended September 30, 2025.
